title: TrustTab agent-trust manifest
description: Declares which forms on a site are safe and correctly structured for an AI agent to act on. Served at /.well-known/agent-trust.json, or linked from the homepage <head> with <link rel="agent-trust-manifest" href="..."> on platforms that reserve /.well-known/. Version 1.0 (DRAFT — subject to change until the first stable release).

name.description: Name of the service that verified and signed this manifest.

url.description: Base URL of the issuer. Its signing keys are published at <url>/.well-known/jwks.json and badge lookups resolve at <url>/api/verify/<verification_id>.

verification_id.description: Stable identifier for this site in the issuer's registry.

domain.description: Hostname this manifest applies to (lowercase, punycode, no leading www.). Must equal the domain the manifest is served from.

verification_status.description: Outcome of the issuer's latest checks. "verified": every automated check passed. "self_declared": every automated check passed except that one or more forms could not be confirmed automatically and the owner self-attests them (see endpoints[].verified_by). "unverified": otherwise, or not yet checked. Only "verified" means TrustTab confirmed everything.

verified_at.description: When every automated check last passed (verification_status "verified"). Null for any other status, including self_declared.

expires_at.description: After this time the manifest must be treated as unverified.

signature.description: Detached compact JWS (RFC 7515, alg EdDSA / Ed25519) over the RFC 8785 canonical JSON of this entire manifest with site.signature removed. The JWS header's kid identifies the key in the issuer's JWKS.

no_prompt_injection_pledge.description: The site owner pledges that declared pages contain no content intended to manipulate AI agents.

requests_per_minute.description: Maximum requests per minute an agent may make to declared endpoints.

captcha_exempt.description: Whether agents staying within the rate limit are exempt from CAPTCHA challenges.

status.description: Result of the issuer's most recent prompt-injection scan of the declared pages.

purpose.description: What the form is for. This list is maintained centrally in this schema; add new values here (with justification), never per site.

fieldType.description: Field type expression. Base types: string, number, boolean, email, phone, url, date, file. Composites: array<base>, enum[a,b,c] (values: letters, digits, _ and -). A trailing ? marks the field optional.

path.description: Path of the page containing the form, relative to the site root.

method.description: HTTP method the form submits with.

schema.description: Map of form input name attribute to field type expression.

agent_safe.description: Whether the site owner declares this form safe for agents to submit.

self_attested.description: The site owner attests that this form exists as declared, for forms TrustTab cannot inspect automatically (e.g. rendered by client-side JavaScript).

verified_by.description: Who vouches for this endpoint as of the latest check: "issuer" if TrustTab's automated check confirmed the form, "owner" if only the owner's self-attestation does, null if neither.
